title: Modern Neural Networks Lab
description: Research-grade implementations and comparisons of modern neural-network architectures. Each architecture track carries a mathematical specification, invariant tests, matched-budget baselines, ablations, machine-readable experiment records, and a report whose claim level is bounded by an explicit claim policy.
